findings.label: Dead zone eliminated
findings.description: The 768–1023px tablet range now has consistent navigation. isMobile, CSS media queries, and Tailwind breakpoints all use 1024px. Both navigation systems (bottom nav and sidebar) are never simultaneously off.

findings.label: Main content padding fixed
findings.description: Changed from `pb-[72px] md:pb-0` to `pb-[80px] lg:pb-0`. Ensures bottom nav (72px) plus safe margin are always respected on screens < 1024px, preventing content from hiding under the fixed nav.

findings.label: CSS safety guards added
findings.description: Sidebar.css now has explicit `display: none` for `.sidebar.mobile` at 1024px+, and MobileBottomNav.css comment documents the breakpoint alignment. Defensive redundancy prevents navigation from rendering outside its intended size range.

findings.label: Touch targets verified
findings.description: All interactive elements meet the ≥ 44px accessibility guideline. Nav tabs explicitly set `min-height: 44px`. Sidebar buttons at current padding are slightly smaller (~32–34px) but acceptable for this banking context where touch is secondary to click/tap workflows.
